groups.saying_opens: إذا أسلمت النصرانية قبل زوجها بساعة
سئل عطاء عن امرأة من أهل العهد أسلمت

notes: Three sayings, each with its own isnad, so each group carries its saying (rule 4a). The Quran verse at the end has no isnad and gives no group.
«وقال مجاهد» has no transmitter before him: a single-link group (rule 10).
